d: At 53, when polio left Dr. Santhapan Jones confined to a wheelchair, life took an unexpected turn. But he refused to let his condition define his future. A man of knowledge, compassion and quiet determination, he turned his own struggle into a purpose greater than himself. In Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, he established a home for children affected by polio, becoming their mentor, companion and beloved “Grand Uncle.” His story is a beautiful reminder that sometimes, the greatest way to move forward is to help others rise.
